attributes.digest: The unique name of the internal string.
attributes.description: Similar to an array, dictionary, or matrix, all string objects have a name. If no name is given, a unique one is assigned automatically. If two string objects share the same name, they also share the same memory, so updating one will update the other.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Convert a list to a string.
messages.description: Convert an incoming list to a string, then output the string.

messages.name: append
messages.digest: Append a list to the string.
messages.description: Convert a list to a string, then append it to the currently stored string value.

messages.name: atoms
messages.digest: Convert the string to a list of atoms.
messages.description: Separate the string on every space character, then send the list out the middle outlet. Commas and other special characters are escaped. If you want to separate on another character, use.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Reprocess previously received values and trigger output.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Clear the currently stored string value.
messages.description: After clearing, the contents of the string object will be the empty string.

messages.name: string
messages.description: The contents of the received string are copied to the internal string. The internal string is not renamed.
